tha-ap43:2.1: nivatthohaṁ tidaṇḍaparidhārako bhikkhusaṅghaparibyūḷhaṁ → nivattho haṁ tidaṇḍaparicāraṇo bhikkhusaṅghaparibbūḷhaṁ (pts)
tha-ap43:2.2: tidaṇḍaparidhārako bhikkhusaṅghaparibyūḷhaṁ → tidaṇḍaparicāraṇo bhikkhusaṅghaparibyuḷhaṁ (sya-all) | tidaṇḍaparidhārako → dhāraṇe (bj: sī.selu); parivāraṇo (bj: PTS) | tidaṇḍaparicāraṇo → S1 G. M. tidaṇḍuparidhāraṇo. (pts note)
tha-ap43:2.3: bhikkhusaṅghaparibyūḷhaṁ → bhikkhusaṁghaparibbūḷhaṁ (bj) | bhikkhusaṅghaparibbūḷhaṁ → G. bhikkhusaṅghe-; S1 bhikkhusaṅghaṁ-. (pts note)
tha-ap43:3.4: santhaviṁ → G. satthavi; S1 santhavi. (pts note)
tha-ap43:4.4: antalikkhacarā → antaḷikkhavarā (bj); antalikkhe (sya-all) | sadā → sadā carā (sya-all) | antalikkhacarā sadā → antalikkhe padesagā (pts) | sadā → antaḷikkhe padesagā (bj: PTS) | padesagā → S1 G. M. carā sadā. (pts note)
tha-ap43:6.1: ca → S2 gandhabbā. (pts note) | ye → S1 M. pabbate so ye. (pts note)
tha-ap43:6.4: kalāyapi → kalāyopi (sya-all, pts) | kalāyapi → kalāyo (bj: sī.selu, PTS) | pi → G. kalāpi; M. kalāyo jina sujjare. (pts note)
tha-ap43:7.1: mohandhakārapakkhando → mohandhakārapakkhanno (bj, sya-all); mohandhakāraṁ pakkhanto (pts) | Mohandhakāraṁ → S1 G. M. vogandhākāraṁ. (pts note) | pakkhanto → S1 pakkanto. (pts note)
tha-ap43:8.4: tamogato → honti lokā tamogatā (bj: sī.selu) | tamogato → S1 honti lokā tamogatā. (pts note)
tha-ap43:10.1: padhānapahitattosi → padhāpahitattosi (bj); padhānaṁ pahitattosi (sya-all, pts) | si → S1 G. M. pi. (pts note)
tha-ap43:11.3: nabhaṁ abbhuggamī → nabhe abbhuggami (sya-all) | dhīro haṁsarājāva → vīro haṁsarājā va (pts) | abbhuggamī → G. samuggami. (pts note) | vīro → S1 G. dhīro. (pts note)
tha-ap43:13.2: opammehi → upamehi (sya-all) | samāyutaṁ tamahaṁ → samāyanaṁ tam ahaṁ (pts) | samāyanaṁ → S1 G. samāyutaṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap43:17.3: hīnova → bhinova (bj) | santo → S2 abhijāyo santo. (pts note)
tha-ap43:18.1: so → so ca (bj, sya-all, pts) | pabbajitvāna virājetvāna → pabbajitvā virājitvāna (sya-all)
tha-ap43:18.4: nibbāyissatināsavo → nibbāyissatanāsavo (bj, pts); nibbāyissatyanāsavo (sya-all) | anāsavo → G. nibbāyissati 'nāsavo. (pts note)
tha-ap43:21.1: cānukampī → cānukampi (bj) | cānukampī → S1 M. mā 'nukampī. (pts note)
tha-ap43:26.1: bhāgineyyupālittherassāpadānaṁ → bhāgineyyaupālittherassa apadānaṁ (bj) | bhāgineyyaupālittherassa → bhāgineyyaupālittherassa (aṭṭhakathā); sīhalakkharamuddita potthake “bhāgineyya” iti na dissate (bj note)
